Finding_Text: Software engineering team pushed hardcoded AWS production secret keys and API credentials into public GitHub repository
Production PostgreSQL database snapshot backups have not undergone quarterly automated restoration and recovery testing
Single sign-on enforcement audit revealed 14 contractor accounts lack mandatory hardware security key multi-factor authentication
Customer personally identifiable data stored in cold S3 archiving buckets is unencrypted at rest without KMS key rotation
Production Kubernetes ingress firewall allows unrestricted external 0.0.0.0/0 traffic to internal Redis cache cluster
Third-party payroll SaaS vendor SOC 2 Type II attestation report expired 8 months ago without renewed security assessment
Quarterly vulnerability scanning identified 12 unpatched critical kernel CVEs on external-facing customer API gateways
Application central audit logs lack automated real-time SIEM alerting for anomalous administrative privilege escalation events
Physical access badges to server room and network wiring closet were not revoked for 3 employees terminated last month
Code merge pipeline allowed developer pull request to merge into main branch without mandatory second-engineer peer review
